name: Réti Opening
blurb: Hypermodern and flexible. Answers to 1...d5 (2.c4 and the 2.g3 KIA), 1...Nf6, 1...c5, 1...f5 and more.

name: Italian Game
blurb: Giuoco Piano and Two Knights with the modern c3/d3 plans.

name: London System
blurb: A solid Bf4/e3/c3 setup against ...d5 and King's Indian setups.

name: Ruy Lopez
blurb: Closed main lines (Chigorin, Zaitsev, Breyer), the Open Ruy, the Anti-Marshall and the Anti-Berlin 4.d3.

name: Scotch Game
blurb: Open the centre at once: the Mieses with 4...Nf6 and the 4...Bc5 lines.

name: Vienna Game
blurb: The Vienna Gambit with f4, plus the positional Bc4/d3/f4 setup.

name: King's Gambit
blurb: Kieseritzky, Schallopp and the modern 3...d5, plus the Classical Declined and Falkbeer.

name: Evans Gambit
blurb: Morphy and Kasparov's pawn sacrifice for a big centre: accepted, declined and Lasker's 5...Be7.

name: Queen's Gambit
blurb: The White side of the QGD (Tartakower, Exchange, Elephant Trap), the QGA, Slav, Albin and Chigorin.

name: Catalan
blurb: Open and Closed Catalan plus 4...Bb4+, with the g2-bishop pressure explained.

name: English Opening
blurb: Reversed Sicilian (incl. the Botvinnik clamp), the Symmetrical, and the Mikenas Attack.

name: King's Indian Attack
blurb: One system against the French, Sicilian and Caro-Kann: e5 wedge and a kingside attack.

name: Bird's Opening
blurb: A reversed Dutch with b3/Bb2 and the e5 outpost, plus how to meet the From's Gambit.

name: Jobava London
blurb: The aggressive London: Nc3 and Bf4 with Nb5 tricks and the h4 push.

name: Caro-Kann Defence
blurb: Classical, Advance, Exchange/Panov and Two Knights.

name: Queen's Gambit Declined
blurb: Tartakower, Exchange, Catalan and the London, plus the Elephant Trap.

name: Sicilian Defence
blurb: Najdorf, Dragon, Sveshnikov and Accelerated Dragon, plus the Alapin and Moscow.

name: French Defence
blurb: Advance (incl. Milner-Barry), Winawer (Poisoned Pawn), Tarrasch and Exchange.

name: Scandinavian
blurb: 3...Qa5 and 3...Qd6 with ...c6 and ...Bf5, plus 3.Nf3 and 3.d4.

name: Pirc Defence
blurb: Austrian Attack, 150 Attack, Classical and Byrne.

name: Alekhine Defence
blurb: Modern 4.Nf3, Four Pawns, Exchange and 2.Nc3.

name: Petroff Defence
blurb: The Russian Game: 3.Nxe5 with 5.d4 and 5.Nc3, plus 3.d4.

name: Berlin Defence
blurb: The Berlin Wall endgame, the 5.Re1 line and the Anti-Berlin 4.d3.

name: King's Indian Defence
blurb: Classical (Ne1 and Bayonet), Sämisch, Four Pawns, Fianchetto and vs the London.

blurb: Exchange (Bc4 and Rb1), 4.Bf4 and the Russian/Hungarian.

blurb: Main line 4...dxc4 5.a4 Bf5 (and 6.Ne5), 4.e3 Bf5, Chebanenko and Exchange.

blurb: Leningrad setup, plus the Staunton Gambit, 2.Nc3/Bg5 and the London.

name: Modern Benoni
blurb: Classical with Be2/Nd2, the Fianchetto and the dangerous Taimanov.

name: Queen's Indian
blurb: 4.g3 Ba6, the Petrosian 4.a3, 4.e3 and 4.Nc3.
